question: Songkran is a Buddhist festival. This festival is celebrated for several days in the month of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** April.**__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] Key Points__

__
 
• The Buddhist festival 'Songkran' is celebrated mainly in Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• This Buddhist festival is observed as a spring cleaning.
 
• It is celebrated for several days during the middle of April, people clean their houses wash clothes and enjoy sprinkling perfumed water on the monks. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
